# BSM Holdings

> BSM Holdings provides residential property management in the Oklahoma City metro, with clear owner reporting and direct resident support.

BSM Holdings manages single-family homes, duplexes, townhomes, and apartments throughout the Oklahoma City metro.

- Contact: ty@bsmholdings.com
- Service area: Oklahoma City metro (Oklahoma City, Edmond, Norman, Moore, Yukon, and surrounding communities)

## Services

- **Property management** — leasing, rent collection, maintenance coordination, and financial reporting for rental property owners.
- **Properties** — browse available rentals managed by BSM Holdings.

## Brand and naming

- The company name is **BSM Holdings**.
- BSM Holdings is a residential property management company serving the Oklahoma City metro.
- Resident Login links directly to the external resident portal.
